title.narrative: Enterprise Expansion Fund (ENEF) II Technical Assistance & the Star Venture Programme under the Western Balkans Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility (WB EDIF)

description.narrative: The action is implemented under the Western Balkans Enterprise Development and Innovation Facility ( WB EDIF). The programme will have 2 main goals: 1) to support the deployment of the second phase of the Enterprise Expansion Fund (an equity fund for the Western Balkans) and more precisely the Fund adviser's capacity; 2) provide assistance for the development of local start-up ecosystem via capacity building for start-ups, incubators and accelerators.
